Synapse allows users to configure an unbounded number of push rules with an unbounded total size, potentially causing disk space exhaustion.
These rules are then loaded back into memory when requested, or when processing push rules for new events, leading to memory exhaustion.

Homeservers that trust all their local users are not affected.

### Patches

Update to Synapse 1.157.2 or later.

See the table below for patched versions of [Element Server Suite](https://element.io/en/server-suite), including Long-Term Support (LTS) versions.
|  | 25.10 LTS | 26.4 LTS | Latest |
|:--|--|--|--|
| **ESS Pro** | `25.10.14+lts` | `26.4.9+lts` | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS Classic** | `25.10.09-gui` | `26.04.04-gui` | ⸻ |
| **ESS Community** | ⸻ | ⸻ | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS TI-Messenger** | `25.10.10` | `26.4.5` | `26.7.0` |

### Workarounds

None known.

### Identifiers

-  ELEMENTSEC-2026-1071
